items.title: The Cash Machine The Market Put On Sale: LOW
items.summary: The home improvement giant is generating far more cash than the median S&P 500 company, yet the market keeps walking away. Here’s the offer, the catch, and the one number that will settle the debate.

items.title: Why Is Wall Street Doubting Google Stock?
items.summary: After a sharp pullback, one of the world's most dominant companies is trading at a steep discount to the market, forcing investors to decide if they are looking at a bargain or a warning sign.

items.title: AI Is 'Accelerant' For Clients, Says S&P Global CFO
items.summary: Eric Aboaf, CFO of S&P Global, said that his business is to create transparency around hyperscalers for investors as the AI buildout shows no signs of slowing down. Aboaf, who was joined by Bloomberg's Nina Trentmann, said that AI is also an 'accelerant' for S&P Global on the client and revenue side of the business, as feature to help clients access key data.

items.title: AppLovin Stock Has Already Taken A Shock-Sized Fall Without A Shock
items.summary: Its shock history says it falls much harder than the index, and the decline it is living through arrived while the index was climbing.

items.title: Is Microsoft Stock A True Safe Haven When The Market Stumbles?
items.summary: The correlation to the index is high, the five-year record shows wider swings for slightly less return, and neither of those says diversification.

items.title: Is RKLB Stock A Buy Or A High-Beta Trap?
items.summary: The multiple rests on a launch vehicle that has yet to fly and an acquisition that has yet to close, while most of the revenue arriving today comes from satellites.

items.title: Why Is IonQ Stock Sinking?
items.summary: Rigetti fell nearly as far over the same stretch while IBM and Honeywell held up far better, a split narrow enough to locate the move in how the quantum story is priced, not in anything IonQ reported.

items.title: S&P Global (SPGI) Up 4% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
items.summary: S&P Global (SPGI) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.
